steps: Parathormone increases blood calcium, Calcitonin decreases it; they are antagonistic.
Insulin decreases blood glucose, Glucagon increases it; they are antagonistic.
Aldosterone increases sodium reabsorption (raises BP), ANF decreases blood pressure; they are antagonistic.
Relaxin facilitates childbirth by relaxing pelvic ligaments; Inhibin inhibits FSH secretion; they have unrelated physiological functions.
